'''Mitrinomon Transports''' was the company that manufactured the [[Z-6 jetpack/Legends|Z-6 jetpack]]. They were an underground specialty shop that catered to [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
